description: Retrieval eval over sample-docs/. A retrieved chunk is relevant when it comes from expectedSource and contains the evidence phrase (whitespace-insensitive). Questions are paraphrased so they do not simply repeat the document wording.

questions.question: How many vacation days do I get each year?
How many unused holiday days can roll over into next year?
questions.evidence: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over

questions.question: When do I need a doctor's note for being off ill?
How long is the paid leave for the main caregiver after a baby arrives?
questions.evidence: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

questions.question: After how long at the company can I take an unpaid break of a few months?
How much memory does a developer's computer come with?
What is the minimum length for a login password?
Do I have to connect to the VPN to read my email?
questions.evidence: Email, chat and the HR portal work without it

questions.question: My phone with the authenticator app got lost. What now?
questions.evidence: call the service desk to have your MFA reset

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim after buying something?
What is the maximum I can spend per night on accommodation?
Will the company pay for a business class ticket?
How much can I spend on food per day on a work trip?
Is there a budget for buying a desk and chair for working at home?
What is the price of the Team plan?
questions.evidence: Team costs 6 EUR per user per month

questions.question: Can I try the product before paying, and for how long?
How big can uploaded files be on the free tier?
questions.evidence: 10 MB per file on the Free plan

questions.question: I removed our workspace by mistake. Can it be recovered?
questions.evidence: restored by an admin for 30 days

questions.question: How many days a year can I work while staying abroad?
questions.evidence: up to 20 working days per calendar year

questions.question: During which hours should meetings be scheduled?
Does the company contribute to my home broadband bill?
What does it cost to replace a lost access card?
When is the kitchen refrigerator emptied?
How quickly does support respond when the service is completely down for a Business customer?
What compensation do we get if availability falls under 99 percent?
questions.evidence: Below 99.0 percent, the credit is 25 percent

questions.question: How do I flag a suspicious email?
How soon are a leaver's accounts switched off?
questions.evidence: all accounts are disabled within 4 hours

questions.question: After how long does my screen lock by itself?
